title: coleonema rubrum
intro: Coleonema rubrum, commonly known as the Red Form or Scarlet Form of the Coleonema, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It is native to South Africa and is known for its fragrant, pinkish-red flowers and glossy green leaves. Coleonema rubrum has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
